patch_management_enabled.title: Automated Patch Management Enabled
patch_management_enabled.description: Whether an automated patch management system (e.g., WSUS, SCCM, Intune, Jamf, Ansible) is actively configured and enforcing patch deployment across the device fleet.

fleet_patch_compliance_percent.title: Fleet Patch Compliance Percentage
fleet_patch_compliance_percent.description: Percentage of managed devices currently compliant with the required patch level as reported by the patch management system.

patch_scope.title: Patch Management Scope
patch_scope.description: The breadth of device coverage enforced by the automated patch management system.

max_patch_age_days.title: Maximum Allowed Patch Age (Days)
max_patch_age_days.description: The maximum number of days a critical or high-severity patch is permitted to remain unapplied before enforcement action is triggered, as defined in patch policy.

automated_deployment_enabled.title: Automated Patch Deployment Enabled
automated_deployment_enabled.description: Whether patch deployment is set to occur automatically without requiring manual approval or initiation for each patch cycle.

max_patch_deployment_days.title: Maximum Days to Full Fleet Patch Deployment
max_patch_deployment_days.description: The configured maximum number of days allowed between patch release and enforced deployment to managed endpoints for critical/high severity patches, as defined in patch management policy.

compliance_reporting_enabled.title: Patch Compliance Reporting Enabled
compliance_reporting_enabled.description: Whether the patch management system is configured to generate compliance status reports and retain audit trails showing patch state across the fleet.

report_frequency.title: Report Generation Frequency
report_frequency.description: How frequently compliance reports are generated and updated.

per_device_tracking_enabled.title: Per-Device Patch State Tracking
per_device_tracking_enabled.description: Whether the system tracks and reports patch compliance at the individual device level rather than only aggregate statistics.

audit_trail_retention_days.title: Audit Trail Retention Period (Days)
audit_trail_retention_days.description: Number of days patch compliance history and audit logs are retained.

staging_environment_exists.title: Staging Environment Exists
staging_environment_exists.description: Whether a dedicated pre-production staging or test environment is provisioned and used for patch validation before fleet-wide deployment.

patch_testing_policy.title: Patch Testing Policy
patch_testing_policy.description: The enforced policy governing whether patches must pass a validation stage before production deployment.

minimum_staging_dwell_days.title: Minimum Staging Dwell Period (Days)
minimum_staging_dwell_days.description: The minimum number of days a patch must remain validated in the staging environment before being promoted to production fleet deployment.

rollback_enabled.title: Automatic Rollback Enabled
rollback_enabled.description: Whether the patch management system is configured to automatically roll back patches that fail deployment or cause system instability.

rollback_trigger_type.title: Rollback Trigger Configuration
rollback_trigger_type.description: The conditions under which automatic rollback is triggered — whether based on installation failure codes, post-patch health checks, or both.

known_good_snapshot_policy.title: Known-Good State Snapshot Policy
known_good_snapshot_policy.description: Whether the system maintains pre-patch snapshots or checkpoints that enable recovery to a known-good state prior to patch application.

patch_scope_coverage.title: Patch Scope Coverage
patch_scope_coverage.description: Indicates whether the patch management solution covers both OS updates and third-party application updates, only OS updates, only third-party updates, or neither.

patch_deployment_windows_configured.title: Patch Deployment Windows Configured
patch_deployment_windows_configured.description: Whether scheduled maintenance windows have been defined for patch deployment, restricting patch application to approved time periods.

deployment_window_enforcement_mode.title: Deployment Window Enforcement Mode
deployment_window_enforcement_mode.description: Whether the deployment window schedule is actively enforced (patches only applied in window), optional/advisory, or disabled.

inventory_discovery_enabled.title: Endpoint Inventory and Discovery Enabled
inventory_discovery_enabled.description: Whether automated discovery and inventory scanning is actively enabled to detect managed and unmanaged endpoints on the network.

inventory_scan_frequency_hours.title: Inventory Scan Frequency (Hours)
inventory_scan_frequency_hours.description: How often (in hours) the system performs automated scans to refresh the endpoint inventory and detect new or changed devices.

unmanaged_device_detection_enabled.title: Unmanaged Device Detection Enabled
unmanaged_device_detection_enabled.description: Whether the system is configured to specifically flag and alert on devices found in inventory that lack patch management agent coverage.

software_version_tracking_enabled.title: Software Version Tracking Enabled
software_version_tracking_enabled.description: Whether the inventory system records and maintains current software/OS version data for each discovered endpoint.

signature_verification_enabled.title: Patch Signature Verification Enabled
signature_verification_enabled.description: Whether cryptographic signature verification is enabled for patches before installation, ensuring only vendor-signed updates are applied.

trusted_source_enforcement.title: Trusted Patch Source Enforcement
trusted_source_enforcement.description: Whether the patch management system enforces that updates are sourced exclusively from trusted, vendor-approved repositories or update servers.

hash_validation_enabled.title: Patch Hash/Checksum Validation Enabled
hash_validation_enabled.description: Whether cryptographic hash or checksum validation of patch files is performed prior to installation to detect tampering or corruption.
